description: We are a team of ambitious high school students passionate about STEM, physics, AI, and space. We're here to build real, impactful solutions! Our strengths include research, creative problem-solving, AI tools, visual storytelling, and pitching. Why join us? We have tons of energy, fresh ideas, and a friendly vibe. Looking for: teammates skilled in coding (Python, web/app), data analysis, or UI/UX & 3D design. Join our crew!
